Silver-grey hair in high rounded bun crossed by horizontal brown wooden hairpin extending viewer left, two long side locks. Ivory outer robe with large pale blue-grey cloud motifs near sleeve hems, slate-blue crossing inner robe and wide blue sash tied at viewer right. Short dark wrapped sword hilt with bronze pommel and blue tassel peeks behind viewer-right arm. Arms and hands not visible. Preserve mole, high bun, pin, cloud motif placement and sword hilt.
